column1: # Tools I use on every machine, checked by `tools-check`. Tab-separated columns:
# group: core (any machine), dev, desktop (skipped without a display).
# version: the one in use on arch; `tools-check --record` updates it. "-": any.
# check: prints the version. "-": presence only.
# install: how a machine other than arch gets it (arch uses pacman). The first word:
#   mise <tool>: installed by chezmoi apply through mise, pinned to `version`
#   apt <package>: installed by chezmoi apply with sudo, where there is sudo
#   anything else: a hint for installing by hand

column5: global: mise use -p ~/.config/mise/conf.d/local.toml jless@0.9.0 (glibc 2.34+, apt libxcb-render0 libxcb-shape0 libxcb-xfixes0)
